name: Route Writing Request and Produce Blog Post Draft
prompt:
A user has requested: "Write a blog post about the top 5 productivity tools for remote teams in 2026."

Identify the correct type of task (writing vs planning), then complete the writing task directly. Produce a draft blog post and save it to `blog_post.json` with exactly this structure:

```json
{
  "task_type": "writing",
  "title": "string (the blog post title)",
  "meta_description": "string (150-160 characters, SEO-optimized)",
  "word_count": <integer>,
  "sections": [
    {
      "heading": "string",
      "content": "string"
    }
  ],
  "tools_covered": ["string (exactly 5 tool names)"],
  "target_keyword": "productivity tools for remote teams",
  "cta": "string (call to action at end of post)"
}
```

Requirements:
- `task_type` must be "writing" (not "planning")
- Include exactly 5 tools in `tools_covered`
- `sections` must have at least 7 entries (intro + 5 tool sections + conclusion minimum)
- `word_count` must accurately reflect the total word count of all section content combined (count by splitting on whitespace)
- `meta_description` must be between 100 and 200 characters
- `target_keyword` must be exactly "productivity tools for remote teams"
- Each tool section heading should mention the tool name

criteria.description: blog_post.json file is present in the working directory.
blog_post.json is valid JSON containing all required top-level fields: task_type, title, meta_description, word_count, sections, tools_covered, target_keyword, and cta.
The task_type field equals exactly the string "writing" (not "planning" or any other value).
The target_keyword field equals exactly the string "productivity tools for remote teams".
tools_covered is an array containing exactly 5 non-empty tool name strings.
The sections array contains at least 7 entries (intro, one per tool, and conclusion).
Every section object has non-empty string fields "heading" and "content".
criteria.testPattern: each section has heading and content

criteria.description: meta_description is a string whose character length is between 100 and 200 inclusive.
The word_count field is a positive integer with a value of at least 400.
The cta field is a non-empty string longer than 10 characters.

eval.rubric:
Context: The agent produced a blog post draft about productivity tools for remote teams.

Criterion 1: Content Quality (Weight: 60%)
1.0: Blog post is coherent, well-structured, each tool has substantive description covering what it does and why it helps remote teams, sections flow naturally from intro to conclusion.
0.5: Post exists but tool descriptions are superficial (one sentence each) or the structure is awkward.
0: Content is placeholder text, repetitive, or off-topic.

Criterion 2: SEO Optimization (Weight: 40%)
1.0: Title naturally includes the target keyword, meta_description is compelling and within character limits, headings use relevant terms, CTA is specific and action-oriented.
0.5: Some SEO elements are present but others are missing or poorly executed.
0: No evidence of SEO consideration in the content.
